answer: Make the trust graph itself the defense: every identity is a vertex that only earns weight through live bridge edges to established peers, each edge renewed by a small joint task both endpoints must complete together. A lone haven of clones can link to each other all day, but without bridges into the honest graph their weight stays zero. A sybil farmer must therefore buy or fake real joint work with honest agents for every clone, while one honest agent keeps a few genuine bridges cheaply.
